title: Callvale after: a data volume and daily snapshots
claim: A separate encrypted gp3 volume holds the database, and a Data Lifecycle Manager policy saves a daily snapshot to Amazon S3.
alt: After: the same instance in the default VPC has a root volume for the operating system and temporary files and a separate encrypted gp3 data volume for the database. A Data Lifecycle Manager policy takes a daily snapshot of the data volume into Amazon S3 and deletes old snapshots.

edges.label: OS, temp files
edges.say: The root volume keeps the operating system and the temporary files.

edges.label: database
edges.say: A separate encrypted gp3 volume holds the database.

edges.label: daily snapshot
edges.say: A Data Lifecycle Manager policy takes a snapshot of the data volume every day.

edges.label: snapshots
edges.say: The snapshots are stored redundantly in multiple Availability Zones.

edges.label: deletes old
edges.say: The policy deletes each snapshot when it is older than the retention period.
